about: A daily series at 19:00 New York (00:00 UTC the next day), a day given its own notes and the change undone (no row, no skip), the series made all-day, then the redo. Since the gate (decisions.md, "An undo acts on a day only where the journal says exactly where it is") the redo is refused as not_undoable, with nothing written here or sent: the day had no row and no skip when the series was re-placed, so nothing recorded where it went, and it is never placed by its key or its date (x-day).
